audit.interpretation: No leakage: the score is arithmetically correct. But Gaussian Naive Bayes reaches nearly the same accuracy, and features are uncorrelated within each crop, which together indicate a synthetic dataset of well-separated classes rather than a strong model. Quote the noise-robust figure operationally.
